status.title: Status
status.subtitle: Services, queues and the latest runs.
status.pipelineIntro: Each document travels left to right. Two background queues do the work; the search index at the end is what you search.

source.title: Nextcloud
source.desc: Your watched folders. Read only — nothing is ever written back.

crawlStage.title: Crawl
crawlStage.desc: Walks the folders level by level (PROPFIND), spotting new and changed files by their ETag. Queues each one for processing.

processStage.title: Process
processStage.desc: Downloads the file, extracts text and metadata via Tika (OCR for scans), renders the preview image, and writes the document into the search index.

indexStage.title: Search index
indexStage.desc: Meilisearch. Once a document lands here it is findable.

status.runTypeHint: A full run reprocesses every file; a changes-only run touches just what changed since last time.
status.clearConfirmBody: {count} queued jobs will be discarded. Documents already in the index stay untouched — anything not yet processed is picked up again on the next run.
status.indexActionFailed: The action could not be completed.
status.rebuildConfirmBody: The index and all document records are dropped, then every folder is crawled and processed from scratch. This takes a while — search stays incomplete until it finishes.
status.clearIndexConfirmBody: Every document is removed from the index and its record. Search returns nothing until you rebuild or the folders are crawled again. This cannot be undone.
